items.title: No Specific Allocation Under 2026 Budget For GLP-1 Drugs: Dzulkefly
items.summary: MOH doesn't have a specific allocation under Budget 2026 for GLP-1 drugs used to treat obesity and type 2 diabetes. A total of 240 applications for the medicine were approved from January to September 2026 under a Special Approval Medication mechanism. items.title: Act 852 Unproven In Combating Vape: Ex-Poisons Board Member
